input.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
input.rationale: The only limitation of liability in the Agreement (p0077, buried at the end of the indemnity section) caps TrueLink alone at 12 months' hosting and support compensation and leaves Client's liability wholly unlimited, including under the broad Client indemnity in Section 12a. A one-way cap protecting only the Vendor is walk-away territory under LOL-CAP, so the clause fails the fallback on mutuality and on carve-outs (only gross negligence and wilful misconduct are excluded, and only for TrueLink; indemnification and confidentiality breaches sit inside the cap). We therefore target the fallback: the existing 12-month fees basis is retained, the cap is made mutual, and indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct are placed outside it. We also replaced the reference to Sections 3, 4 and 11, which do not exist in this Agreement, with the Agreement as a whole so the cap is operable. Preferred-level items (USD 1,000,000 floor, mutual consequential-damages waiver, data protection, fraud, IP infringement carve-outs and the payment-obligations exclusion) are not pursued at this level.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.

proposal.summary: Make the 12-month fees cap mutual and carve out indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
